title: Multisubject, multimodal face processing
description: A multi-subject, multi-modal neuroimaging dataset on face processing, combining structural MRI, functional MRI, MEG and EEG from 16 healthy young volunteers. Each participant was scanned once with MRI and once with MEG while viewing famous, unfamiliar and scrambled faces. Faces were shown initially or repeated immediately or after a delay, giving a 3x3 design. Participants made a symmetry judgment on each stimulus. The dataset supports multimodal integration and face repetition research.
methods_description: Participants viewed famous, unfamiliar and scrambled face images, either first presentations or immediate or delayed repeats. They judged each image's symmetry with a button press. Each participant completed one MRI/fMRI session and one MEG/EEG session. Three anatomical fiducials were digitized for MEG-MRI alignment. Empty-room MEG recordings were collected across 7 sessions. The first two fMRI dummy volumes were removed, and T1 images were defaced with FSL.
